ticket_window_local.timezone_note: Internet2 GRNOC publishes ticket times in US Eastern time. EDT = UTC−4.

target.label: UVA via Internet2
target.prefix_selection: origin AS225 AND baseline AS path contains AS11537
target.prefix_selection_provenance: Manual analyst mapping: AS225 = University of Virginia (the participant named in the ticket); AS11537 = Internet2 (the network through which UVA connects). We select only prefixes originated by UVA whose pre-event baseline path traverses Internet2, as those are the routes that could be affected by the I2 participant relationship unavailability.

collectors_provenance: RouteViews peers with broad global visibility. Selected for IPv4/IPv6 coverage of AS225 prefixes.
analyst_notes: The ticket title 'Availability - I2 Participant UVA' has no parenthesized site code. This is expected to derive a ParticipantRelationshipUnavailable (NonRedundant) expectation distinct from the Redundant RIPE event (INC0302574).
Event window is 1h21m (02:35–03:56 EDT ≡ 06:35–07:56 UTC). We add 60 minutes of warm-up before and cool-down after to observe baseline, transition, and restoration.

Prefixes are selected by scanning the preceding RIB for origin AS225 routes whose AS path contains AS11537 (Internet2). This is a manual selection — no automatic participant-to-ASN mapping is performed.

Possible verdicts: ExpectedParticipantUnavailability, ExpectedAlternateRouting, PartialImpact, UnexpectedContinuedInternet2Path alongside existing NoObservableBgpImpact, InsufficientVisibility, Indeterminate.

Broker discovery is used to locate RIB and UPDATE files; caching avoids repeated downloads. If broker is unreachable or archives are unavailable, the analysis will report INSUFFICIENT_VISIBILITY or an archive error.
UVA (AS225) is a university network with limited global BGP visibility. InsufficientVisibility is a legitimate outcome if AS225 prefixes are not observed by the selected RouteViews collectors.
